import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

C_BLUE       = '#0072B2'
C_ORANGE     = '#E69F00'
C_VERMILLION = '#D55E00'
C_GREEN      = '#009E73'
C_PURPLE     = '#CC79A7'

VC = {
    'mmlu': {
        'model': 0.0065213123,
        'model:item': 0.0695501891, 'model:prompt': 0.0036708012,
        'model:seed': 6.88512e-05, 'model:temp': 0.0001007978,
        'model:ordering': 6.40528e-05, 'residual': 0.0575714452,
    },
    'arc': {
        'model': 0.0054499659,
        'model:item': 0.0597623659, 'model:prompt': 0.0141751724,
        'model:seed': 2.69593e-05, 'model:temp': 1.65634e-05,
        'model:ordering': 0.0, 'residual': 0.0273654728,
    },
    'hellaswag': {
        'model': 0.0110182355,
        'model:item': 0.0741053211, 'model:prompt': 0.000387514,
        'model:seed': 4.71108e-05, 'model:temp': 8.87438e-05,
        'model:ordering': 0.0, 'residual': 0.0440750888,
    },
    'gsm8k': {
        'model': 0.0268400916,
        'model:item': 0.036345528, 'model:prompt': 0.021308241,
        'model:seed': 2.30489e-05, 'model:temp': 0.0002267272,
        'model:ordering': 0.0, 'residual': 0.0996441838,
    },
    'math': {
        'model': 0.0176297619,
        'model:item': 0.0357840757, 'model:prompt': 0.0034490834,
        'model:seed': 1.49585e-05, 'model:temp': 7.27458e-05,
        'model:ordering': 0.0, 'residual': 0.0908925174,
    },
}

DESIGNS = {
    'full':   {'n_p': 6, 'n_s': 6, 'n_t': 2, 'n_o': 4},
    '3x3':   {'n_p': 3, 'n_s': 3, 'n_t': 1, 'n_o': 1},
    'single': {'n_p': 1, 'n_s': 1, 'n_t': 1, 'n_o': 1},
}

DESIGN_STYLES = {
    'full':   {'color': C_BLUE,       'ls': '-',  'label': 'Full (6p×6s×2t×4o)'},
    '3x3':   {'color': C_ORANGE,     'ls': '--', 'label': '3×3 (3p×3s)'},
    'single': {'color': C_VERMILLION, 'ls': ':',  'label': 'Single (1×1×1×1)'},
}

SENSITIVITY = {
    'mmlu':      {'n_765': 145, 'n_800': 178, 'n_835': 225, 'delta_n': 41, 'pct': 23.0},
    'arc':       {'n_765': 43,  'n_800': 53,  'n_835': 66,  'delta_n': 13, 'pct': 24.5},
    'hellaswag': {'n_765': 66,  'n_800': 81,  'n_835': 103, 'delta_n': 19, 'pct': 23.5},
    'gsm8k':     {'n_765': 237, 'n_800': 291, 'n_835': 368, 'delta_n': 67, 'pct': 23.0},
    'math':      {'n_765': 179, 'n_800': 220, 'n_835': 278, 'delta_n': 51, 'pct': 23.2},
}

BM_ORDER = ['mmlu', 'arc', 'hellaswag', 'gsm8k', 'math']
BM_LABELS = {'mmlu': 'MMLU', 'arc': 'ARC', 'hellaswag': 'HellaSwag',
             'gsm8k': 'GSM8K', 'math': 'MATH'}
BM_COLORS = {'mmlu': C_BLUE, 'arc': C_ORANGE, 'hellaswag': C_GREEN,
             'gsm8k': C_VERMILLION, 'math': C_PURPLE}


def compute_G(n, vc, design):
    d = design
    s2m = vc['model']
    cond = d['n_p'] * d['n_s'] * d['n_t'] * d['n_o']
    s2d = (vc['model:item'] / n +
           vc['model:prompt'] / d['n_p'] +
           vc['model:seed'] / d['n_s'] +
           vc['model:temp'] / d['n_t'] +
           vc['model:ordering'] / d['n_o'] +
           vc['residual'] / (n * cond))
    return s2m / (s2m + s2d)


outdir = '/tmp/figures'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

# ====== FIGURE 1: G vs n_items curves (5 benchmarks x 3 designs) ======
n_range = np.logspace(np.log10(10), np.log10(1000), 300)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(7.0, 4.8))

for idx, bm in enumerate(BM_ORDER):
    ax = axes.flat[idx]
    vc = VC[bm]
    for dname in ['full', '3x3', 'single']:
        sty = DESIGN_STYLES[dname]
        G_vals = np.array([compute_G(n, vc, DESIGNS[dname]) for n in n_range])
        ax.plot(n_range, G_vals, color=sty['color'], ls=sty['ls'],
                label=sty['label'] if idx == 0 else None)

    ax.axhline(0.80, color='#888888', ls=':', lw=0.8, alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_title(BM_LABELS[bm], fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_ylim(0.15, 1.02)
    ax.set_xlim(10, 1000)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15)

    if idx >= 3:
        ax.set_xlabel('$n_\\mathrm{items}$')
    if idx % 3 == 0:
        ax.set_ylabel('$G$')

    ax.set_xticks([10, 50, 100, 500, 1000])
    ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(
        lambda x, _: f'{int(x)}'))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())

ax_leg = axes.flat[5]
ax_leg.axis('off')
handles, labels = axes.flat[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
handles.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#888888', ls=':', lw=0.8))
labels.append('$G = 0.80$ threshold')
ax_leg.legend(handles, labels, loc='center', fontsize=10, frameon=False,
              title='Evaluation design', title_fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_curves.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_curves.png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 1 saved: budget_sensitivity_curves.pdf/.png')


# ====== FIGURE 2: Sensitivity band (G=0.80 +/- 0.035) ======
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 2.5))

for i, bm in enumerate(BM_ORDER):
    s = SENSITIVITY[bm]
    c = BM_COLORS[bm]

    ax.barh(i, s['n_835'] - s['n_765'], left=s['n_765'], height=0.4,
            color=c, alpha=0.20, edgecolor=c, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.barh(i, s['n_835'] - s['n_800'], left=s['n_800'], height=0.4,
            color=c, alpha=0.45, edgecolor='none')
    ax.plot(s['n_800'], i, 'D', color=c, markersize=7,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=5)
    ax.text(s['n_835'] + 8, i,
            f"+{s['delta_n']} items ({s['pct']:.1f}%)",
            va='center', fontsize=9, color=c, fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(range(len(BM_ORDER)))
ax.set_yticklabels([BM_LABELS[bm] for bm in BM_ORDER])
ax.set_xlabel('Number of items ($n_i$) for $G = 0.80$')
ax.set_xlim(0, 440)
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis='x')

ax.text(0.98, 0.05,
        '$G = 0.80 \\pm 0.035$ uncertainty band\n'
        '◆ = nominal $n_i$;  darker = budget cost of $|\\Delta G|$',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, ha='right', va='bottom',
        color='#555555',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#f9f9f9',
                  edgecolor='#cccccc', alpha=0.9))

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_band.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_band.png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 2 saved: budget_sensitivity_band.pdf/.png')
PYEOF

    '3x3':   {'n_p': 3, 'n_s': 3, 'n_t': 1, 'n_o': 1},
    'single': {'n_p': 1, 'n_s': 1, 'n_t': 1, 'n_o': 1},
}

DESIGN_STYLES = {
    'full':   {'color': C_BLUE,       'ls': '-',  'label': 'Full (6p×6s×2t×4o)'},
    '3x3':   {'color': C_ORANGE,     'ls': '--', 'label': '3×3 (3p×3s)'},
    'single': {'color': C_VERMILLION, 'ls': ':',  'label': 'Single (1×1×1×1)'},
}

SENSITIVITY = {
    'mmlu':      {'n_765': 145, 'n_800': 178, 'n_835': 225, 'delta_n': 41, 'pct': 23.0},
    'arc':       {'n_765': 43,  'n_800': 53,  'n_835': 66,  'delta_n': 13, 'pct': 24.5},
    'hellaswag': {'n_765': 66,  'n_800': 81,  'n_835': 103, 'delta_n': 19, 'pct': 23.5},
    'gsm8k':     {'n_765': 237, 'n_800': 291, 'n_835': 368, 'delta_n': 67, 'pct': 23.0},
    'math':      {'n_765': 179, 'n_800': 220, 'n_835': 278, 'delta_n': 51, 'pct': 23.2},
}

BM_ORDER = ['mmlu', 'arc', 'hellaswag', 'gsm8k', 'math']
BM_LABELS = {'mmlu': 'MMLU', 'arc': 'ARC', 'hellaswag': 'HellaSwag',
             'gsm8k': 'GSM8K', 'math': 'MATH'}
BM_COLORS = {'mmlu': C_BLUE, 'arc': C_ORANGE, 'hellaswag': C_GREEN,
             'gsm8k': C_VERMILLION, 'math': C_PURPLE}


def compute_G(n, vc, design):
    d = design
    s2m = vc['model']
    cond = d['n_p'] * d['n_s'] * d['n_t'] * d['n_o']
    s2d = (vc['model:item'] / n +
           vc['model:prompt'] / d['n_p'] +
           vc['model:seed'] / d['n_s'] +
           vc['model:temp'] / d['n_t'] +
           vc['model:ordering'] / d['n_o'] +
           vc['residual'] / (n * cond))
    return s2m / (s2m + s2d)


outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0519/projects/nlp_variance_gtheory/artifacts/figures'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

# ====== FIGURE 1: G vs n_items curves (5 benchmarks x 3 designs) ======
n_range = np.logspace(np.log10(10), np.log10(1000), 300)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(7.0, 4.8))

for idx, bm in enumerate(BM_ORDER):
    ax = axes.flat[idx]
    vc = VC[bm]
    for dname in ['full', '3x3', 'single']:
        sty = DESIGN_STYLES[dname]
        G_vals = np.array([compute_G(n, vc, DESIGNS[dname]) for n in n_range])
        ax.plot(n_range, G_vals, color=sty['color'], ls=sty['ls'],
                label=sty['label'] if idx == 0 else None)

    ax.axhline(0.80, color='#888888', ls=':', lw=0.8, alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_title(BM_LABELS[bm], fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_ylim(0.15, 1.02)
    ax.set_xlim(10, 1000)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15)

    if idx >= 3:
        ax.set_xlabel('$n_\\mathrm{items}$')
    if idx % 3 == 0:
        ax.set_ylabel('$G$')

    ax.set_xticks([10, 50, 100, 500, 1000])
    ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(
        lambda x, _: f'{int(x)}'))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())

ax_leg = axes.flat[5]
ax_leg.axis('off')
handles, labels = axes.flat[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
handles.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#888888', ls=':', lw=0.8))
labels.append('$G = 0.80$ threshold')
ax_leg.legend(handles, labels, loc='center', fontsize=10, frameon=False,
              title='Evaluation design', title_fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_curves.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_curves.png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 1 saved: budget_sensitivity_curves.pdf/.png')


# ====== FIGURE 2: Sensitivity band (G=0.80 +/- 0.035) ======
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 2.5))

for i, bm in enumerate(BM_ORDER):
    s = SENSITIVITY[bm]
    c = BM_COLORS[bm]

    ax.barh(i, s['n_835'] - s['n_765'], left=s['n_765'], height=0.4,
            color=c, alpha=0.20, edgecolor=c, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.barh(i, s['n_835'] - s['n_800'], left=s['n_800'], height=0.4,
            color=c, alpha=0.45, edgecolor='none')
    ax.plot(s['n_800'], i, 'D', color=c, markersize=7,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=5)
    ax.text(s['n_835'] + 8, i,
            f"+{s['delta_n']} items ({s['pct']:.1f}%)",
            va='center', fontsize=9, color=c, fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(range(len(BM_ORDER)))
ax.set_yticklabels([BM_LABELS[bm] for bm in BM_ORDER])
ax.set_xlabel('Number of items ($n_i$) for $G = 0.80$')
ax.set_xlim(0, 440)
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis='x')

ax.text(0.98, 0.05,
        '$G = 0.80 \\pm 0.035$ uncertainty band\n'
        '◆ = nominal $n_i$;  darker = budget cost of $|\\Delta G|$',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, ha='right', va='bottom',
        color='#555555',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#f9f9f9',
                  edgecolor='#cccccc', alpha=0.9))

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_band.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/budget_sensitivity_band.png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 2 saved: budget_sensitivity_band.pdf/.png')
